notes.title: Playtesting sign-ups open!
notes.notes:
[b]The Nightmarket Festival 2022[/b] is showcasing around 100 discounted games, and offering free demos for dozens of hot upcoming titles! So as a big thanks to them for inviting me on board, you can go check out all of them games here!

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/nightmarketfest_2022

War In Heaven is participating in The Nightmarket Festival 2022 and although we're not ready to publish, we're definitely ready to open playtest sign-up!

Game mechanics and design takes time and iteration - player-guided feedback helps with the decision making in what stays in the game, and what gets thrown out.

[h2]How to sign up?[/h2]
[url=http://eepurl.com/h74J1X]Just click here and enter your email![/url]

And you don't even have to playtest every single session too. We'd like to collect your interest in participation through a newsletter. We simply request your email to log your interest and there won't be anymore spam mail other than a welcoming email.

[url=http://eepurl.com/h74J1X]Click here to join the playtesting![/url]
